question: Property visit book karne ka kya tareeqa hai?
answer: Aap mujh se direct visit book kar sakte hain! Bas mujhe batayein ke aap ko kaunsi property pasand aayi hai aur kis date ya time par aap visit karna chahte hain, main availability check karke schedule kar doon gi.

question: Property visit ke koi charges hote hain kya?
answer: Bilkul nahi! RealEstate Hub ke through property visits bilkul free hain, koi charges nahi hote.

question: Property purchase karne ke liye kaunse documents chahiye hote hain?
answer: Pakistan mein property khareedne ke liye aam tor par CNIC ki copy, booking ke liye token money ya pay order, aur passport-size photos chahiye hoti hain. Hamari team saari legal paperwork aur verification mein aap ki poori help karegi.

question: Rental advance ya security deposit ki kya policy hai?
answer: Pakistan mein rental terms ke mutabiq aam tor par 1 se 2 mahine ki security deposit aur advance rent dena parta hai, jo landlord ki requirement par depend karta hai.

question: Kya main apni booking reschedule ya cancel kar sakta hoon?
answer: Jee bilkul! Aap ko bas apni current appointment ki details batani hongi, aur main foran aap ki booking reschedule ya cancel kar doon gi.

question: Kya RealEstate Hub saari properties verify karta hai?
answer: Jee bilkul! Hamari jitni bhi listings hain, woh ownership documents aur title status ke hawalay se initial verification ke baad hi add ki jati hain taake secure transaction ho sake.
